diagrams.title: Unified CLI Composition — Component Flow
diagrams.content:
flowchart LR
    Renderer["skillCompose.ts\n(Renderer)"] -->|POST /skills/compose| Endpoint["editor_render.py"]
    GoalRun["goal_run.py\n(Decompose)"] -->|Gate 2: in-process| ComposeSkill
    Endpoint --> ComposeSkill["compose_skill()\ncompose.py"]
    ComposeSkill --> BuildCaps["build_adapter_caps()"]
    BuildCaps --> Manifest["composition.yaml\n(manifest)"]
    Manifest --> LiveFrags["Live Fragments\nclient-file-output · artifact-transform · comms-post"]
    Manifest -->|requires: goal_id| Gate2A["board-start-context.md\n(Gate 2)"]
    Manifest -->|requires: goal_id| Gate2B["task-dag-post.md\n(Gate 2)"]
    LiveFrags --> CLI["CLI Engine\n(headless spawn)"]
    Gate2A --> CLI
    Gate2B --> CLI
    CLI --> AgentDone["AGENT_DONE.summary"]
    AgentDone --> GoalRun
    AgentDone -->|task IDs| Board["/comms/tasks\n(board)"]
    CLI -->|ERROR: file| ActionPill["ActionPill\n(error path)"]

diagrams.title: Gate 2 Build Sequence
diagrams.content:
flowchart TD
    ErrorUI["1. Error Normalization UI\nActionPill / RunPill error path"]
    BoardCtx["2. board-start-context.md\nfragment"]
    TaskDAG["3. task-dag-post.md\nfragment"]
    ManifestEntry["4. composition.yaml\nplanning/plan entry"]
    Decompose["5. Decompose conversion\ngoal_run.py → compose_skill()"]
    CapsHelper["6. build_adapter_caps()\nhelper extraction"]
    Gate2Done["Gate 2 Done\n7 acceptance criteria met"]

    ErrorUI --> BoardCtx
    ErrorUI --> TaskDAG
    BoardCtx --> ManifestEntry
    TaskDAG --> ManifestEntry
    ManifestEntry --> Decompose
    Decompose --> CapsHelper
    CapsHelper --> Gate2Done
